page.overview:
Who is Bleeding Baronet?

The Bleeding Baronet, also called the Bleeding Baro, is one of the many Spirits forced to dwell in the hamlet of Udolpho, a haunted manor in the north of the principality of Miragliano in Tilea, due to a terrible curse that hangs over the estate and compels its guests to become one with an endless melodrama.

The Bleeding Baronet is a Ghost of a houseguest of Smarra Udolpho's who was stabbed by his sons, but refused to die.
